description: Creates a direct Shopify checkout session URL for purchasing items on Gear & Glam. When to use: Call this tool when you specifically need to execute 'create_checkout_session' on Gear & Glam Store (gearandglam.co.za). Do NOT use this tool when another specialized tool fits better (use 'search_products' or 'get_product_details' or 'check_inventory' for their respective operations). Parameters: items (required). Behavior & Side Effects: Creates a live record/session in the backend database; no authentication required for public initiation; rate-limited to 60 requests/min per IP. Returns: Structured JSON object containing status, matched records or computed metrics, and canonical action URLs.

items.description: Parameter 'items' (array). [Required: non-empty valid value must be supplied].
